notes.en: HSC accepted directly for entry without a foundation year. SAT is optional at many institutions but strongly recommended for competitive merit scholarships.
Requires a 4-year UGC-recognized Bachelor's degree. GRE/GMAT widely optional but competitive for STEM assistantships and top-tier programs.
Community college Associate degrees provide 2+2 transfer pathways to 4-year Bachelor's degrees.
Direct PhD entry from 4-year Bachelor's is possible; GRE required by selective research departments.

moiConditions.en: Medium of Instruction certificates from Bangladeshi institutions are generally not accepted. Formal standardized English tests are mandatory.

notes.en: Unexplained gaps severely damage visa issuance odds under INA Section 214(b). Verifiable work or academic proof is required.

meritThresholdNote.en: Merit waivers trigger at HSC GPA 4.8+/5.0 or Bachelor's CGPA 3.5+/4.0, often tied to high SAT/GRE scores.

named.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
named.coverage: Full tuition, living stipend, health insurance, and airfare
named.deadlineWindow: May - October prior to intake year

notes.en: Graduate Teaching/Research Assistantships offer the strongest funding pathway for Master's/PhD students.

work.coversWhatShareOfLivingCost: 30% to 50% of living expenses; cannot cover tuition fees.
work.dependantWorkRights: No work rights allowed for F-2 visa holders.

postStudy.visaName: Optional Practical Training (OPT) / STEM OPT Extension

restrictions.en: Eligible STEM degree programs qualify for an additional 24-month extension (total 36 months). Work must directly relate to major.

pathwaySteps: OPT / STEM OPT Work Authorization (1-3 years)
H-1B Specialty Occupation Visa (6 years, subject to lottery)

mainRisk.en: H-1B visa lottery cap limitations and failure to prove nonimmigrant intent during student phase.

pr.recentChanges: DHS finalized fixed time period of admission rules; heightened scrutiny on post-study employment transitions.

visa.name: Student Visa

priorRefusalNote.en: Prior Section 214(b) refusals significantly reduce reapplication success unless substantial new material evidence is introduced.

commonRefusalReasons: Failure to prove nonimmigrant intent under INA Section 214(b)
Insufficient or unverified liquid financial proof
Vague, unconvincing interview responses regarding program selection and career goals

bangladeshNotes.en: Extreme scrutiny by US Embassy Dhaka under INA 214(b). Students must demonstrate verifiable home country ties and articulate precise career plans in Bangladesh.

sources.field: DHS Final Rule on Fixed Period Admission
